description: Optimal hyperparameter configuration for REINFORCE on LunarLander-v3

phase1_learning_rate.rationale: 3e-4 provides the best balance between convergence speed and stability for Adam optimizer on policy gradient tasks. Lower rates (1e-4, 5e-5) converge too slowly; higher rates (1e-3) cause instability.

phase2_network_architecture.rationale: [256, 128] offers sufficient capacity for the 8D LunarLander observation space while avoiding over-parameterization. The decreasing layer sizes create a hierarchical feature extraction pipeline.

phase3_gamma.rationale: gamma=0.99 appropriately weights future rewards for landing tasks that require planning ~300-500 steps ahead. Lower values (0.95) are too myopic; 0.995 can increase variance excessively.

phase4_training_frequency.rationale: 4 learn steps per episode maximizes sample efficiency. Buffer size 4096 ensures diverse experience replay. Batch size 512 gives stable gradient estimates without excessive memory cost.
